business_problem: With innovation in its DNA, British Sugar is continuously looking to build upon and adapt its operations to maintain its competitiveness on the global sugar market.
solution_summary: Historically, decision-making at the company relied predominantly on the expertise, intuition and experiential knowledge of practiced employees who had been with the business for decades. This technical knowledge was often passed down through training schemes, shared experiences and stories. And, while this approach has been effective for more than a century, contemporary technology and the approaching retirement of many employees presented an opportunity for change. To stay ahead, British Sugar needed to embrace new frameworks that codify and scale experience across all data, leveraging its ability to adapt and thrive in a rapidly changing market.
business_outcome: By partnering with one of our well-trusted transformational partners, IBM Consulting, and embracing cutting-edge Microsoft technologies, British Sugar has not only reduced costs and waste but also empowered its teams to focus on high-value tasks, ensuring long-term competitiveness and innovation in the sugar industry.
metrics: Having built one of the first digital twins in sugar manufacturing, British Sugar is at the forefront of technological innovation in the industry.
The connected systems that were built also eliminated silos and boosted production efficiencies, which allowed real-time adjustments and a reduction in manual interventions.
